name: Limberg Mining Company
operations: Opencast and underground chrome/PGM mine on the farms Schildpadnest, Zwartkop, Roodedam, Middellaagte and Elandskuil near Thabazimbi (mining right granted 2010); Thaba Joint Venture beneficiation plant with Sylvania Metals; subsidiary of ChromTech Holdings; head office Ground Floor, Building 31, The Woodlands Office Park, Woodmead, Johannesburg (+27 11 035 3950, info@limberg.co.za). NOTE: CRM province hint was Mpumalanga; the company's own site places the mine in Limpopo.
scale_note: Beneficiation plant annual capacity 13,000 oz 4E PGMs and 420,000 t chrome concentrate; environmental authorisation (14/12/16/3/3/1/2852) for a Limberg 40 MVA 132/11 kV substation and a Middellaagte 2 x 40 MVA 33 kV substation; plant 'partially powered by solar PV'
status_flag: active - producing chrome/PGM mine with commissioned beneficiation plant

name: M-Resources
operations: Self-described 'budding Mineral Resources focused start-up' offering mining and exploration services from an office at 1F, 173 Oxford Road, Rosebank, Johannesburg (+27 87 265 5444, info@mresources.co.za). No mine, project, right or commodity is named anywhere on the site; latest dated content is December 2022.
status_flag: exploration-only - start-up with no identified site, right or operating load; cannot establish what it actually mines from official sources

name: Manganese Metal Company (MMC)
commodity: Electrolytic manganese metal (99.9% selenium-free EMM); high-purity manganese sulphate monohydrate (HPMSM)
operations: EMM refinery at 15 Heyneke Street, Industrial Area, Mbombela (+27 13 759 4600), operating since 1974; MTX-1 HPMSM plant in commissioning (2026); on-site hazardous landfill at Kingston Vale; Japan sales office (M's & Co). Electricity is c.41% of production cost; NERSA approved a two-year Eskom Negotiated Pricing Agreement (1 Aug 2026 - 31 Jul 2028) to bridge to a renewable PPA already concluded for c.70% of consumption.
scale_note: c.360 GWh/yr baseload at >90% load factor (approx. 41 MW average); c.28,000 t/yr EMM; 380 employees + 280 contractors (Engineering News, 19 Aug 2026, reporting the NERSA NPA decision)
status_flag: active - operating refinery; NOTE a renewable PPA covering c.70% of load is already contracted per the NERSA record

name: Mbuyelo Coal
operations: Three 100%-owned operating opencast collieries in Mpumalanga: Manungu (Delmas; also underground resources), Ntshovelo and Mavungwani; part of Mbuyelo Group (Minerals Council SA member, listed under Coal). Head office No 2 Robin Close, Infinity Office Park Block A, Meyersdal, Gauteng (011 867 0836, info@mbuyelocoal.com); regional office Bureau De Paul Block 6, Route N4 Business Park, Mandela Avenue, Witbank/eMalahleni (013 656 3733).
status_flag: active - three operating opencast mines; no production or electricity figures published

name: MC Mining
commodity: Hard coking coal and thermal coal
operations: Makhado Project (36 km north of Makhado town, Limpopo; MC Mining 95%, IDC 5%, reducing to 69% post-BEE) - Phase 1 moved from construction into commissioning in 2026 with steady-state production targeted by end-2026; Eskom grid power per project page. Uitkomst Colliery (20 km NW of Utrecht, KZN) - mining and processing temporarily suspended from 1 March 2026. Vele Colliery (48 km W of Musina, Limpopo) - care and maintenance since October 2013. ASX primary / JSE secondary listing; Kinetic Development Group is the controlling investor. SA office Ground Floor, Greystone Building, Fourways Golf Park, Roos Street, Fourways (+27 10 003 8000).
scale_note: Makhado Phase 1 design c.3.0 Mtpa ROM yielding c.0.54 Mtpa hard coking coal + c.0.57 Mtpa thermal (project page); July 2026 announcement describes the plant as c.4 Mt ROM per year; total resource base 2.4 Bt in situ
status_flag: active - Makhado in commissioning (new Limpopo load); Uitkomst suspended Mar 2026; Vele on care and maintenance

name: Miracle Upon Miracle Investments
commodity: Platinum group metals (Merensky and UG2 reefs) with chrome co-product
operations: Miracle Upon Miracle Investments (Pty) Ltd (MUM) is the South African rights holder for the Bengwenyama PGM-chrome project on the farms Nooitverwacht 324 KT and Eerstegeluk 327 KT, Eastern Limb of the Bushveld (c.7 km west of Steelpoort, 22 km SW of Burgersfort, adjoining Modikwa). MUM is 70% owned by ASX/JSE-listed Southern Palladium Limited (Sydney; info@southernpalladium.com) and 30% by the Bengwenyama-ya-Maswazi community. Mining Right granted August 2026; DFS well advanced; Stage 1 production targeted 2029. MUM has no website of its own - the parent's is given.
status_flag: exploration-only - pre-development project (mining right Aug 2026, DFS in progress, first production targeted 2029); no operating load today

name: Msobo Coal
operations: Opencast coal mining and processing c.20 km north of Ermelo in the Breyten/Carolina area (Msukaligwa Municipality); established 2012; headquartered in Breyten. Listed by the Minerals Council SA as a member under Coal, with no website link. The domains msobo-coal.co.za and msobo.co.za both failed to resolve on 19 Sep 2026, so no company-published contact or leadership page could be read; directory listings (Kompass/D&B) give 50 Hoy Street, Breyten but are not company sources.
scale_note: c.6 Mt ROM coal per year; 900 employees + 1,500 contractors; Eskom c.38% of sales (Mining Outlook, 2026 - trade press, not a company publication)
status_flag: active - operating mine per Minerals Council membership and 2026 trade profile, but company website unreachable so nothing could be confirmed from the company itself

name: Mvelo Minerals
operations: Could not be established from official sources. The only company site found (mveloresources.com) failed DNS on 19 Sep 2026; the company is not on the DMPR Northern Cape operating-mines list and is not a Minerals Council SA member. The only descriptive source is a January 2015 Mining Weekly profile of founder/executive chairman Sarel Daantjie describing contract mining services in the Northern Cape (stale, >10 years). CIPC registrations exist for Mvelo Minerals SA (K2016300434), Mvelo-Mineral Resources (K2014161070) and Mvelo Mining (K2016426075) per b2bhint.
status_flag: dormant - unverifiable: no reachable website, no operating-mine listing, no official filing found; treat as unconfirmed until the company itself can be reached

name: New Venture Mining Investments
commodity: Chrome (LG3/LG4 reefs) per court record; listed by Minerals Council SA under platinum as an 'Investment company'
operations: No company website or filing found. The Minerals Council SA lists 'New Venture Mining Investments' as an investment-company member with no website. North West High Court judgment WD Mining v New Venture Mining Investment Holdings and Others (M107/22, 15 Aug 2023) records the company as holder of a chrome mining right in North West with a contract-mining agreement cancelled July 2020 and site access halted in 2021 over unpaid rental to the landowner; earlier ZANWHC cases (2017, 2018) concern termination agreements with Scormin and Goudini.
scale_note: Contract stipulated 10,000-20,000 t/month minimum production (historic, not current)
status_flag: dormant - court record (Aug 2023) shows the mine was not operating from 2021; no official site, so current load cannot be confirmed

name: Nkwe Platinum
operations: Zijin Garatau Platinum Mine on the Eastern Limb of the Bushveld, c.25 km NW of Steelpoort and 30 km WNW of Burgersfort. Nkwe Platinum Limited (Bermuda; 100% Zijin Mining Group) holds 74% of the mining right, Genorah Resources 26%; day-to-day operations contracted to South Africa Zijin Platinum (Pty) Ltd. Construction launched May 2021 (boxcut from 28 May 2021, c.4 years to first ore, USD 700m capex per Zijin); 3rd-generation SLP covers 2024-2028. Head office 2nd Floor, Building 18, Woodlands Office Park, 20 Woodlands Drive, Sandton (010 591 3989). Minerals Council SA member (Platinum).
scale_note: Planned 3.6 Mtpa ore at full capacity (Phase 1 1.8 Mtpa); c.2,500 jobs once fully operational; mine life >29 years
status_flag: active - mine in development/ramp-up under a Chinese parent; SA operating entity is South Africa Zijin Platinum (Pty) Ltd

name: Ntsimbintle Mining
operations: Ntsimbintle Mining (Pty) Ltd holds 50.1% of Tshipi e Ntle Manganese Mining (Pty) Ltd, operator of the Tshipi Borwa open-pit mine at 331 Mamatwan Farm, Kathu, Kalahari Manganese Field (Jupiter Mines 49.9%). OWNERSHIP CHANGE: on 27 Feb 2026 Exxaro Resources (via Exxaro Manganese Mining) acquired 100% of Ntsimbintle Mining, 100% of Ntsimbintle Marketing, 19.99% of Jupiter and 9% of Hotazel Manganese Mines from Ntsimbintle Holdings and OMH for R10.6bn; Ntsimbintle Holdings (Houghton, +27 11 483 0840) no longer owns the mining entity. Tshipi offices: Sable Building, Fairway Office Park, 52 Grosvenor Road, Bryanston (+27 11 367 8940); mine +27 53 742 4000. Exxaro head office Centurion (+27 12 307 5000).
scale_note: Tshipi Borwa >3 Mt manganese ore per year (Ntsimbintle Holdings site); 'largest single manganese mine and exporter from South Africa' (Tshipi site); c.30 years of reserves
status_flag: active - operating mine, but the prospect entity is now a 100% Exxaro subsidiary (since 27 Feb 2026); route via Tshipi/Exxaro, not Ntsimbintle Holdings

name: Petra Diamonds
operations: Cullinan Diamond Mine (underground, Tshwane, Gauteng - listed as operating on the DMPR Gauteng register) and Finsch (Northern Cape); each 74% Petra, 14% Kago Diamonds, 12% Itumeleng Petra Employee Trust. Finsch was placed into business rescue on 29 May 2026 (small-stone price collapse; c.34% of FY2025 group revenue). Williamson (Tanzania) and Koffiefontein sold. LSE-listed; group office London; SA office Silver Point Office Park, Block 3, 22 Ealing Crescent, Bryanston (+27 11 702 6900, info@petradiamonds.com; procurement GRP_Vendors@petradiamonds.com).
scale_note: Total energy 1,417,000 GJ in FY2025 (FY2024: 1,906,000 GJ); Scope 2 356,028 tCO2e FY2025 (96% of footprint); electricity intensity 51.14 kWh/t; Cullinan 1,453,008 ct and Finsch 975,828 ct produced FY2025; long-term wheeled renewable PPAs with Etana Energy for 36-72% of each operation's load
status_flag: active - Cullinan operating; Finsch in business-rescue since 29 May 2026; renewable wheeling PPAs already contracted (Etana)

name: Platinum Group Metals Ltd
commodity: Platinum group metals (63% palladium) and base metals
operations: Waterberg Project, a bulk underground PGM deposit on the Northern Limb of the Bushveld Complex, held by Waterberg JV Resources (Pty) Ltd: Platinum Group Metals 37.19% (50.16% effective), Implats 14.86%, HJ Platinum (JOGMEC/Hanwa) 21.95%, Mnombo Wethu Consultants 26%. Mining right granted early 2021; DFS update Sept 2024; company is 'assessing commercial alternatives for mine development financing and concentrate offtake' ahead of a construction decision (Jan 2026); staged plan considers 'deferring capital for power lines'. TSX/NYSE American-listed, Vancouver HQ; SA office Third Floor, 35 Ferguson Road, Illovo, Johannesburg (+27 11 782 2186, info@platinumgroupmetals.net).
scale_note: Proven and probable reserves 246.2 Mt at 2.96 g/t 4E (23.41 Moz 4E, 100% basis); no production
status_flag: exploration-only - advanced development project with no construction decision; foreign (Canadian) parent; no SA operating load today

name: Rainbow Rare Earths
commodity: Rare earths (NdPr oxide; Dy, Tb, Y in mixed carbonate) recovered from phosphogypsum
operations: Phalaborwa project: recovery of rare earths from the phosphogypsum stacks of the historic Foskor/Sasol phosphoric acid operation at Phalaborwa; Rainbow 85% (option over remaining 15%). DFS underway; construction planned 2027, first production 2028; site has access to Eskom grid via an existing HV switchyard and the company is exploring renewable options. Registered Guernsey, LSE:RBW; contact page lists Guernsey and London offices only - no South African office or phone.
scale_note: Planned c.1,850 tpa separated NdPr oxide + c.80 tpa Dy/Tb + c.140 tpa Y; 2.2 Mt/yr phosphogypsum processed over a 16-year life; interim economic study NPV10 US$611m (Dec 2024)
status_flag: exploration-only - pre-construction (build 2027, first production 2028); foreign parent with no SA operating load yet

name: Rockwell Diamonds
operations: Former TSX/JSE-listed alluvial diamond miner in the Middle Orange River area of the Northern Cape (Wouterspan, Saxendrift, HC van Wyk Diamonds). The three SA subsidiaries - Rockwell Resources RSA (Pty) Ltd, HC van Wyk Diamonds Ltd and Saxendrift Mine (Pty) Ltd - were placed in provisional liquidation by interim order of the Kimberley High Court on 23 March 2017; the parent announced its intention to wind up its affairs in January 2021.
scale_note: Wouterspan plant was rated c.200,000 m3/month (historic, pre-2017)
status_flag: dormant - SA subsidiaries in liquidation since 2017, parent wound up 2021; no operating load
